'''IT-904''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Interrogation droid/Legends|Interrogation droid]] who was purchased by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dej Vennor]] in an auction. Vennor modified the droid, which included giving it new programming and additional armaments, allowing him to use it to help him in collecting bounties. However, the programming changes did result in the droid developing a sarcastic personality.
